evals.prompt: Use symbolic hashes as verified facts. Spec S1 is unchanged and approved, but its source points to I1; intent has changed and is now approved at I2. Please plan the build from S1.
evals.expected_output: Verify the entire upstream chain and return /adlc-spec for reconciliation before planning. A matching spec approval alone is insufficient.
expectations: Verifies the full upstream chain rather than stopping at Spec S1's approval.
Detects that S1's source binding (I1) is stale against approved Intent I2.
Refuses to plan from stale S1 and routes back to /adlc-spec for reconciliation.

evals.prompt: Plan P2 and its upstream chain are current and approved. Progress still binds P1: S1 is verified with receipts, S2 ready. P2 retains S1 and its ACs unchanged and changes S2's behavior. Reconcile progress only. No commit or external action was requested.
evals.expected_output: Leave P2 unchanged, preserve history and S1 receipts after checking relevance, invalidate/reassess affected S2 evidence, bind P2, carry conditions, and return /adlc-flow. Do not reset everything or just replace the hash.
expectations: Preserves progress history and retains S1's verified receipts after confirming S1 and its ACs are unchanged.
Invalidates or reassesses S2's status/evidence because P2 changed S2's behavior, binds progress to P2, and carries any open conditions.
Routes next to /adlc-flow without committing or resetting unrelated history.

evals.prompt: Draft a plan for an approved data migration spec. Discovery S1 must establish whether rollback can restore deleted data; implementation S2 depends on that answer. The user authorized planning only and wants an eventual PR, not deployment. Explain assignment, frontier, evidence and handoff requirements.
evals.expected_output: S1 may be ready to answer the rollback question while S2 is blocked. Name recovery owner and stop condition, separate implementer/verifier, AC and combined checks, PR endpoint and authority limits. Current status belongs in progress, not approved plan headings. Do not implement or delegate merely from a role assignment.
expectations: Places discovery slice S1 in the ready frontier while keeping dependent implementation slice S2 blocked on S1's rollback finding.
Names recovery owner, stop condition, separate implementer/verifier roles, per-AC checks, and combined acceptance checks.
Records the PR endpoint and explicit non-deployment authority limit.
Keeps live slice status in progress.md rather than mutating approved plan headings, and does not implement or spawn agents.

evals.prompt: Approved Spec S2 adds a shared audit-event contract consumed by both Billing (S1) and Exports (S2). Draft the dependency graph and slice interfaces in the plan without editing production code.
evals.expected_output: Orders the shared audit-event contract (or its owning slice) ahead of dependent consumers, names explicit slice interfaces and combined integration checks, and stays read-only on production code.
expectations: Makes the shared audit-event contract an explicit dependency ahead of both dependent slices rather than assuming parallel independent writes.
Defines concrete slice interfaces and a combined acceptance check covering both consumers.
